hypothesis: An explicit string-array output contract can remove the observed universal object-array mismatch. Test basic structural capability before interpreting parser effects.
change: Only the second-stage planner output-format instruction changes; all four real arms reuse their exact original first-stage outputs and same frozen planner weights. Oracle is diagnostic only.
budget: At most 720 new planner calls / one GPU hour, including 30-call smoke. Reused compiler/summary costs are counted in reconstructed pipeline costs separately from new compute.
decision: First two groups in the pre-existing fixed panel, not outcome-selected. Require >=5/6 string arrays in each arm AND >=3/6 strict valid plans in both direct and oracle before automatic expansion. No criterion uses SFT superiority. If smoke fails, preserve outputs, do not run the remaining 46 groups; next establish one common planning-format SFT starting point on train only.
interpretation: Exploratory dev recovery after observing failure, not preregistered confirmation. Do not replace original all-zero results or normalize the primary output schema post hoc.
